title: Excessive standing privilege on production database consoles
description: All engineering team members have read access to production database query consoles without time-bounded elevation or approval workflow. Insider-threat exposure to customer PII.
currentMitigations: Query audit logs retained 90 days. Quarterly access reviews run manually via spreadsheet.

title: Shared service-account credentials in CI pipelines
description: Build pipelines authenticated to AWS via long-lived static credentials shared across team members. Rotation tied to engineer offboarding only.
currentMitigations: Migrated CI to OIDC federation; static credentials removed; rotation no longer a manual concern.

title: Backup encryption keys held by single cloud provider
description: Backup encryption keys and the backup storage both reside in AWS. A provider-wide compromise would expose both the data and the means to decrypt it.
currentMitigations: Risk accepted by CTO; provider lock-in trade-off documented. Re-evaluated annually.

title: Customer PII retained beyond stated retention policy
description: Soft-deleted user records in the primary database are not hard-purged on the documented 90-day timeline. Cleanup job has failed silently for the last two cycles.
currentMitigations: Cleanup job alarms wired to PagerDuty as of 2026-03-01. Backlog purge in progress.

title: PII handling in support tooling
description: Customer support agents can view full unredacted PII in the support console. No data-masking enforced for non-DPA-trained agents.

title: Single-source dependency on the customer authentication provider
description: Login depends entirely on one identity provider. A provider-side outage takes 100% of customers offline. No secondary IdP integration.
currentMitigations: Provider's SOC 2 reviewed annually; SLA credits negotiated. No technical mitigation in place.

title: Patch lag on customer-facing edge fleet
description: Patch SLA target is 14 days for critical CVEs on edge nodes. Last quarter's average was 23 days due to deployment-window constraints.
currentMitigations: Deployment windows widened to weekends; canary fleet now patches T+24h.

title: Disaster recovery RTO not tested for primary region failure
description: Documented RTO is 4 hours for total-region loss but tested only at the per-service level. Full-region failover never end-to-end tested.
currentMitigations: Per-service failover validated quarterly; runbook exists for region-loss but unverified.
